featured_reviews.name: PD
featured_reviews.review_text:
A midnight birthday surprise is a carefully orchestrated operation—coordinating friends and family, hiding gifts, managing timings, and making sure everything comes together right at the stroke of twelve. Amidst all the chaos, it's comforting to know that Merwans has the most important part covered: the cake.

This time, we picked the Chocolate To Kill Cake, and it absolutely lived up to its name. Layers of chocolate sponge were paired with rich Dutch truffle, white truffle, and a combination of dark and white mousse, creating a decadent chocolate experience from the first bite to the last. The sponge was soft and moist, the mousse added a light, velvety texture, and the contrasting dark and white chocolate flavours struck a perfect balance of richness and sweetness.

What impressed me most was how indulgent the cake felt without becoming overly heavy. Every slice disappeared quickly, and it was easily the highlight of the celebration. For a cake that looks festive, tastes premium, and delivers maximum crowd appeal, this one is hard to beat.

When the countdown to midnight begins and you need a cake you can trust to make the moment special, Merwans rarely disappoints. A dependable favourite that's helped create countless sweet memories across Mumbai.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Maratha Bakery in Wadala isn't just a bakery; it's a neighbourhood fast food snack centre. For years, it's been serving up a delicious blend of traditional Marathi snacks and baked goods, becoming a beloved staple for locals and a must-try for visitors.

Here's what I love about Maratha Bakery:

The Snacks: This is where Maratha Bakery truly shines. Their misal pav is a must-try – a fiery and flavorful concoction that's perfectly balanced with the soft, buttery pav. The vada pav is another classic, perfectly seasoned and fried to a golden crisp. And don't miss the batata vada, crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside. Their snack selection is consistently fresh and delicious, offering a true taste of Marathi cuisine.

The Baked Goods: While snacks are their speciality, the bakery side doesn't disappoint. Their khari biscuits and toasts are incredibly flaky and buttery, perfect with a cup of chai. They also offer a range of fresh breads, cakes, and pastries, all made with care and attention to detail.

The Prices: Maratha Bakery offers incredible value for money. You can enjoy a satisfying and delicious meal without breaking the bank, making it the perfect spot for a quick lunch, an afternoon snack, or a sweet treat.

Things to consider:

Limited Seating: This is primarily a takeout place, with limited seating available. Be prepared to enjoy your snacks on the go or find a nearby spot to sit.

Peak Hours: During peak hours, especially lunchtime, the place can get crowded. Be prepared to wait in line, but trust me, it's worth it.

Overall:

Maratha Bakery is a true gem in Wadala. It's a place that consistently delivers delicious, authentic Marathi snacks and baked goods at unbeatable prices. If you're looking for a taste of local flavour and a true neighbourhood experience, don't hesitate to visit. I highly recommend it!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Oven Fresh Dadar used to be one of my favorite places, which is why this visit was especially disappointing. We were a group of 6 and were given an extremely cramped table with barely enough space to sit comfortably. The place was also so loud that it was difficult to even have a proper conversation.

The service was honestly pathetic. The staff was very rude and completely uninterested in helping us. No one was responsive to our table, and we had to repeatedly ask for basic things like menus and service. At one point we literally had to call the restaurant’s phone number just to get someone to bring us the menu.

The food itself tasted good, but the quantity felt surprisingly little for the price. Also the pastry we ordered did not seem fresh at all - it felt old and dry instead of soft and fresh.

Really sad to see the experience go downhill because Oven Fresh was genuinely one of my go-to places earlier.
